abstract: OBJECTIVE: To assess the diagnostic value of fine needle aspiration cytology (FNAC) in ovarian lesions. METHODS: This was a retrospective study of ultrasound-guided (US) FNAC of 584 ovarian lesions from January 1998 to July 2010. The lesions were categorized into non-neoplastic lesions, neoplastic lesions and inadequate aspirates. The results were compared with the corresponding histopathology whenever available. RESULTS: Of the 584 lesions, 180 (30.8%) were reported as non-neoplastic (48 non-specific inflammation, 11 tuberculosis, 63 functional cysts and 58 endometriotic cysts), 249 (42.6%) as neoplastic (81 benign lesions/tumours and 168 malignant) and 155 (26.5%) as inadequate. Based on the subsequent histopathology, which was available in 121 (20.7%), the cases were divided into those that were concordant and discordant. Concordant cases comprised 92/121 (76%), including 28 non-neoplastic lesions (seven non-specific inflammation, nine functional cysts and 12 endometriotic cysts), 42 surface epithelial tumours (13 benign and 29 malignant), 10 germ cell tumours (five mature cystic teratomas and five mixed germ cell tumours), seven sex-cord stromal tumours (three granulosa cell tumours, one sclerosing stromal tumour, one strümal leutoma, one Sertoli Leydig cell tumour and one malignant Sertoli cell tumour) and five miscellaneous lesions (one plasma cell tumour, two leiomyosarcomas and two cases of necrosis). Discordant cases comprised 29/121 (24%) (21were inconclusive or inadequate on cytology), including four endometriotic cysts, 14 surface epithelial tumours (one cystadenofibroma, one borderline mucinous tumour and 12 carcinomas), five germ cell tumours (two immature teratomas and three mature cystic teratomas), two thecomas, one fibroma, one sclerosing stromal tumour, one fibrosarcoma and one myxoma. FNAC sensitivity for a diagnosis of malignancy was 85.7%, specificity 98.0%, positive predictive value 97.7%, negative predictive value 87.7% and accuracy 92.0%, if 21 inconclusive/inadequate FNACs were excluded; with the latter taken as false negatives, sensitivity was 73.7% and accuracy 76.0%. CONCLUSION: FNAC has a high specificity for diagnosis of ovarian/adnexal lesions but greater experience is required for the accurate subtyping of neoplasms and sensitivity is limited by inconclusive/inadequate results.
abstract_ja: 目的: 卵巣病変に対する穿刺吸引細胞診(FNAC)の診断的価値を評価する。方法: 1998年1月から2010年7月までに超音波ガイド下FNACを施行された卵巣病変584例を対象とした後方視的研究である。病変は非腫瘍性病変、腫瘍性病変、不適正検体に分類した。結果は、入手可能な場合(121例、20.7%)に対応する病理組織学的所見と比較した。結果: 584病変のうち、180例(30.8%)が非腫瘍性(非特異的炎症48例、結核11例、機能性嚢胞63例、子宮内膜症性嚢胞58例)、249例(42.6%)が腫瘍性(良性81例、悪性168例)、155例(26.5%)が不適正と判定された。その後の病理組織学的所見が得られた121例(20.7%)は、一致例と不一致例に分類された。一致例は92/121例(76%)で、非腫瘍性病変28例(非特異的炎症7例、機能性嚢胞9例、子宮内膜症性嚢胞12例)、表層上皮性腫瘍42例(良性13例、悪性29例)、胚細胞腫瘍10例(成熟嚢胞性奇形腫5例、混合型胚細胞腫瘍5例)、性索間質性腫瘍7例(顆粒膜細胞腫3例、硬化性間質腫瘍1例、strümal leutoma 1例、セルトリ・ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍1例、悪性セルトリ細胞腫瘍1例)、その他の病変5例(形質細胞腫瘍1例、平滑筋肉腫2例、壊死2例)を含んだ。不一致例は29/121例(24%)で(21例は細胞診で判定不能または不適正)、子宮内膜症性嚢胞4例、表層上皮性腫瘍14例(嚢胞線維腫1例、境界悪性粘液性腫瘍1例、癌腫12例)、胚細胞腫瘍5例(未熟奇形腫2例、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫3例)、莢膜細胞腫2例、線維腫1例、硬化性間質腫瘍1例、線維肉腫1例、粘液腫1例を含んだ。判定不能・不適正の21例を除外すると、悪性腫瘍の診断に対するFNACの感度は85.7%、特異度98.0%、陽性的中率97.7%、陰性的中率87.7%、正確度92.0%であった。判定不能・不適正の21例を偽陰性とした場合、感度は73.7%、正確度は76.0%であった。結論: FNACは卵巣・付属器病変の診断において特異度が高いが、腫瘍の亜型分類には経験が必要であり、感度は判定不能・不適正の結果により制限される。
